items.difficulty_reason: 11 行、从纤维上抬 tor 振幅：more-relative-pseudo-coherent-is-moot 引理把 K 化归为 R[x_1..x_d]-模复形；对局部映射 R_p -> A_q 用 perfect-over-regular-local-ring 判据，纤维上同调限在 [a,b] ⇒ K_q 完美且 tor 振幅 [a-d,b]；再由平坦性用 flat-push-tor-amplitude 引理把振幅推回 R 上。承重全在 span 内；3 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-lift-from-fibre-relatively-perfect (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 22180-22190

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the reduction to the polynomial presentation A = R[x_1, ..., x_d] via the relative pseudo-coherence of K, the application of the regular-local-ring criterion at the prime to obtain perfectness with tor amplitude in [a - d, b] over A_q, and the pushforward of the tor amplitude along the flat map R_p -> A_q (source lines 22192-22202)
